topic: Pregnancy pelvic pain: just put up with it?
caption:
Pelvic pain when rolling over in bed during pregnancy? 🤰
Pelvic girdle pain is common — but you don't have to just put up with it.

✔ Roll with knees together
✔ Sit to dress
✔ Shorter steps

Check in with your doctor or midwife, and consider a physio assessment.
